observations.title: mobile Studio keeps critical controls visible and hit-testable after responsive layout changes
observations.detail: Timed out in step switch to four-grid and add an indicator while awaiting chart-2 '3 indicators' after Add click. Diagnostics at failure: layout/visual viewport width 390, window.innerWidth 833, documentElement.clientWidth 390, scrollWidth 833 (excessive horizontal overflow ~443px). activePanel=chart-2. Add button hitTestContainsTarget=true at capture time; scrollY=1664 (deep vertical). Distinguish: horizontal overflow present on topActions/workspace controls; vertical depth normal for Studio; timeout is state-wait not proven overlay interception (elementFromPoint null on offscreen controls is geometry, not overlay).
